description_summary: Record dependency review evidence in dependency-vet.json after a pnpm/npm security audit. Use to inspect, seed, check, clear a justified finding or record an explicitly authorized accepted risk.
should_trigger: Record this reviewed exact package artifact in dependency-vet.json.
Revoke the previous acceptance of this dependency artifact.
Review whether this audit meets our required deployment criterion.
Import a legacy dependency review as unverified evidence.
Record an explicitly accepted risk with the actual reviewer identity.
should_trigger_test: Reject a vetting entry whose integrity no longer matches the lock.
Check whether an old package approval remains valid after a patch changed.
should_not_trigger: Audit the pnpm lock dependency graph for supply-chain risks.
Update compatible dependency patches in the web workspace and verify them.
Review this branch diff for correctness and starter architecture issues.
Freeze edits to the database package for this investigation.
Fetch official Fastify documentation for the version in our lockfile.
